summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on integrating advanced settings into campaign calculations. [p1] noted that while these settings are saved to the database, they do not currently affect the calculation logic. To make them functional, [me] needs to pass necessary data to an endpoint.

[me] highlighted the need to revert to hourly granularity and fully account for time zones, which will complicate query optimization, especially when releasing long-period reports. 

[p1] raised a specific concern regarding the 'share of time' parameter, requesting clarification on its intended use.
action_items: Clarify the purpose and usage of the 'share of time' parameter during the meeting.
